For each significant CpG in Top10:
   a. Identify the chromosome and position.
   b. Select 10 CpGs upstream and 10 downstream (if available) on the same chromosome.
   c. Check that these CpGs are in the beta matrix, remove any missing.
   d. If fewer than 3 CpGs remain, skip.
   e. Write the data and correlation files.
   f. Call comet.web with:
        - image.size = 15 (or 20 if there are many genes) but within allowed sizes.
        - list.tracks set to collapse transcripts.
 We'll adjust the config file to have:
   list.tracks=geneENSEMBL:collapseTranscripts=meta
   
```{r}
library(coMET)
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
library("rtracklayer")

comet.result.dir <- "../../../../results/05_EQTm/sig_DMPs_coMet_plots_AGER/"
#c.result.dir <- "../../../results/06_corr_CpG_celltypes/coMET_CpG_per_celltype/ECvenous/"
dir.create(comet.result.dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = TRUE)
betas <- t(BMIQ.betas.norm.ftr)
#mydata <- df.sig.cpgs.keep[order(df.sig.cpgs.keep$adj.P.Val),]
mydata <- all.res.limma[order(all.res.limma$adj.P.Val),]

# top10 cpgs only
#top10.sig.cpgs.keep <- head(df.sig.cpgs.keep, n=10)

# all 112 significant
df.sig.cpgs.SEO.specific$CpG.id <- rownames(df.sig.cpgs.SEO.specific)

# cell types CpGs
#bcell.cpgs <- c("cg00129232","cg10647833","cg23651812")
#at2.cpgs <- c("cg09238049")
#EC.arterial.cpgs <- c("cg00129232", "cg00766482", "cg08673857", "cg11253122")
#EC.venous.cpgs <- c("cg09297514")

# AGER CpG
AGER.cpg <- c("cg26036029")

filter.cell.type.cpgs <- function(df, cpgs) {
  df %>% filter(CpG.id %in% cpgs)
}
df.sig.cpgs.keep <- filter.cell.type.cpgs(df.sig.cpgs.SEO.specific, AGER.cpg)

run.n <- 0
be.verbose <- FALSE

# Fixed parameters
n.cpgs.surround <- 10  # 10 CpGs on each side = 21 total CpGs (including target)
allowed_sizes <- c(3.5, 7)  # Valid image sizes
configfile <- file.path("./comet_config.txt")

for (cpg in df.sig.cpgs.keep$CpG.id) { # run for top10 or 114 sig CpG
  cpg <- as.character(cpg)
  run.n <- run.n + 1
  message("Processing ", run.n, "/", nrow(df.sig.cpgs.keep), ": ", cpg)
  
  # Create CpG directory
  cpg.dir <- file.path(comet.result.dir, cpg)
  dir.create(cpg.dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  
  # Get target CpG data
  cpg.data <- mydata[mydata$CpG.id == cpg, ]
  
  # Validate data
  if(nrow(cpg.data) == 0 || is.na(cpg.data$pos[1])) {
    message("\tSkipping - missing position data")
    next
  }
  
  # Select 21 CpGs (10 each side + target)
  chr_data <- mydata %>% 
    filter(chr == cpg.data$chr[1]) %>%
    arrange(pos)
  
  idx <- which(chr_data$CpG.id == cpg)
  start_idx <- max(1, idx - n.cpgs.surround)
  end_idx <- min(nrow(chr_data), idx + n.cpgs.surround)
  
  mydata.frame <- chr_data[start_idx:end_idx, ] %>%
    dplyr::select(CpG.id, chr, pos, P.Value) %>%
    dplyr::rename(TargetID = CpG.id,
           MAPINFO = pos,
           Pval = P.Value) %>%
    arrange(MAPINFO)
  
  # Check for missing CpGs in beta matrix
  missing_cpgs <- setdiff(mydata.frame$TargetID, colnames(betas))
  if(length(missing_cpgs) > 0) {
    message("\tRemoving missing CpGs: ", paste(missing_cpgs, collapse=", "))
    mydata.frame <- mydata.frame[!mydata.frame$TargetID %in% missing_cpgs, ]
  }
  
  # Skip if too few CpGs
  if(nrow(mydata.frame) < 2) {
    message("\tSkipping - only ", nrow(mydata.frame), " CpGs available")
    next
  }
  
  # Subset beta matrix
  mydata.betas <- betas[, mydata.frame$TargetID, drop = FALSE]
  
  # Calculate correlation matrix
  listcormatrix.data.raw <- cor(mydata.betas, use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
  
  # Write files
  myinfofile <- file.path(cpg.dir, paste0("mydata_", cpg, ".txt"))
  mycorrelationfile <- file.path(cpg.dir, paste0("mycorrelation_", cpg, ".txt"))
  write.table(mydata.frame, myinfofile, sep = "\t", row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)
  write.table(listcormatrix.data.raw, mycorrelationfile, sep = "\t", row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)
  
  # Use larger image size for gene tracks
  #image_size <- ifelse(7 %in% allowed_sizes, 3.5, 7)
  image_size <- 7
  #########################################################################
  # Add this check before the plotting section
  library(GenomicRanges)
  library(org.Hs.eg.db)
  library(TxDb.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg19.knownGene) # or appropriate genome build
  
  # Check if the CpG is in a gene region
  cpg_pos <- cpg.data$pos[1]
  cpg_chr <- cpg.data$chr[1]
  
  # Create a GRanges object for the CpG
  cpg_gr <- GRanges(seqnames = cpg_chr, ranges = IRanges(start = cpg_pos, end = cpg_pos))
  
  # Get nearby genes (within 50kb)
  genes_nearby <- genes(TxDb.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg19.knownGene)
  distance_to_genes <- distanceToNearest(cpg_gr, genes_nearby)
  
  if (is.na(mcols(distance_to_genes)$distance) || mcols(distance_to_genes)$distance > 50000) {
    message("\tCpG is not near any known genes (distance > 50kb)")
    # You might want to skip this CpG or extend the region
    extend_region <- TRUE
  } else {
    message("\tNearest gene is ", mcols(genes_nearby[subjectHits(distance_to_genes)])$gene_id, 
            " at distance ", mcols(distance_to_genes)$distance)
    extend_region <- FALSE
  }
  # Add this check
  if (!grepl("chr", cpg_chr)) {
    cpg_chr <- paste0("chr", cpg_chr)
    message("\tAdjusted chromosome name to: ", cpg_chr)
  
    # You might need to update your data accordingly
    mydata.frame$chr <- cpg_chr
  }
  # Then use these in your comet.web call:
  
  #########################################################################
  
  # Plot with gene structure details
  tryCatch({
    comet.web(
      config.file = configfile,
      mydata.file = myinfofile,
      cormatrix.file = mycorrelationfile,
      mydata.ref = cpg,
      pval.threshold = 0.05,
      start = 32013573,#min(mydata.frame$MAPINFO),
      end = 32931577, #max(mydata.frame$MAPINFO),
      image.title = paste(cpg, "methylation in COPD vs Controls"),
      image.name = file.path(cpg.dir, paste0(cpg, "_coMet_plot")),
      image.type = "eps",
      image.size = image_size,
      print.image = TRUE,
      verbose = be.verbose

    )
    message("\tSuccessfully created plot")
  }, error = function(e) {
    message("\tERROR: ", e$message)
  })
  
  if (run.n == 1) be.verbose <- FALSE
}
```
